comment: The class of each tool of orm that make rebuild-check checks (S1). The copies of kit under scripts/kit are not listed: kit classifies them.

examples/complex/php/main.php.reason: a runnable example of the PHP client of this repository (docs and README cite it); it shows the product and rebuilds no tool

examples/thin-slice/php/main.php.reason: the thin-slice demo of the PHP client of this repository, timing the generated client against the same SQL through PDO; it shows the product and rebuilds no tool

examples/thin-slice/ts/main.mts.reason: the thin-slice demo of the TypeScript client of this repository, timing the generated client against the same SQL through mysql2; it shows the product and rebuilds no tool

packages/dbspec-language/bin/dbspec-fmt..reason: the command entry of dbspec-fmt, the formatter of the dbspec language that this repository defines; no ecosystem tool formats dbspec

packages/dbspec-lsp/bin/dbspec-lsp.mjs.reason: the command entry of the dbspec language server that this repository defines, over vscode-languageserver; no ecosystem server knows dbspec

packages/php-ext/scripts/build.sh.tool: phpize, configure and make of php-src

packages/ts/src/bin/orm-gen.ts.reason: the command entry of orm-gen, the model generator of this repository; no ecosystem generator reads dbspec

packages/ts/src/tools/cli.ts.reason: orm-gen, the TypeScript model generator from a dbspec set, the product of this repository; no ecosystem generator reads dbspec

scripts/bench-db.mts.reason: recreates and seeds the bench databases of the hot-path gates of this repository through its own generated model and host codecs; no ecosystem seeder knows the dbspec codecs

scripts/case-database-check.mts.reason: the rule of this repository that client cases leave the shared test database as they found it (T25), comparing its tables, rows and schemas before and after; it reads them with mysql2 and pg

scripts/check-rust-150.mts.reason: the scale budget of this repository: 150 generated entities must compile in one Rust crate; it runs polyspec-orm-build and cargo

scripts/check/ci-setup.mts.reason: the setup step of the CI workflow of this repository and the needs it prepares for the check runner; no ecosystem tool states which target needs which setup step

scripts/check/commands.mts.reason: the commands of a check script as data, so the rules of make repo-check on deadlines, leases and test runners hold for them; a rule of this repository

scripts/check/databases.mts.reason: the per-run bench and decimal databases of this repository, created and dropped by each run so no run depends on another; it runs the database clients

scripts/check/downloads.mts.reason: the offline rule of this repository: every check runs without the network, so the downloads must be present; it reads what cargo, go, npm and Composer installed

scripts/check/record.mts.reason: the run record of the check runner of this repository (.runtime/check/<id>/record.json), so a killed run stays recorded as incomplete

scripts/check/report.mts.reason: the report of one full-suite run of this repository, which keeps what each failure needs to be diagnosed without a rerun

scripts/check/run.mts.reason: the check runner of this repository: each run gets its own databases and runs each make target as one step under its own process group and record; no ecosystem runner states these rules

scripts/check/step.mts.reason: one step of the check runner of this repository in its own temporary directory and process group, ended as a group; it uses ps for the group

scripts/check/summary.mts.reason: the CI summary of the run record of this repository, written to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

scripts/ci/php-extension-tools.mts.tool: phpize and php-config of the PHP on PATH

scripts/ci/server-programs.mts.tool: apt-get with the Ubuntu and PostgreSQL apt repositories

scripts/client-db-test.mts.reason: runs the database tests of every client on SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL with the servers of make orm-test-servers, the parity rule of this repository

scripts/comments/check.mts.tool: go/scanner, the TypeScript parser, Python tokenize and ast, and PHP token_get_all

scripts/dbspec/syntax-vectors.mts.reason: writes the token vectors of the dbspec cases from the TypeScript analyzer, so every implementation of the dbspec language is held to them; no ecosystem tool knows dbspec

scripts/decimal-bench-sqlite.mts.reason: prepares the exact-decimal SQLite bench database of this repository under its lease

scripts/decimal-physical-check.mts.reason: the physical rule of this repository that every generated decimal owner leaves the same database state twice; it runs PHPUnit and the TypeScript tests

scripts/docs/check.mts.reason: parse5 reads the HTML of the built site instead of the regular expressions over its tags; item KSTD-5-4-1 moves the link and anchor check to it

scripts/docs/idempotent.mts.reason: the rule of this repository that two builds of the docs are byte for byte equal; it runs vitepress build twice

scripts/docs/lib.mts.reason: serves the built site with node:http without a SPA fallback and records each request, because the docs check must find a deep route that has no HTML page, which a preview server with fallback hides

scripts/docs/markdown-table.mts.reason: mdast-util-from-markdown with mdast-util-gfm reads the Markdown tables instead of splitting lines on the pipe; item KSTD-5-4-1 moves the table reading to it

scripts/docs/rules.mts.reason: mdast-util-from-markdown with mdast-util-gfm reads the Markdown tables instead of splitting lines on the pipe; item KSTD-5-4-1 moves the table reading to it

scripts/features/build.mts.reason: builds the feature document pair from contracts/features.json, the manifest of this repository

scripts/features/check.mts.reason: checks contracts/features.json, the feature manifest of this repository, for what its schema cannot state

scripts/features/coverage.mts.reason: the feature coverage rule of this repository: each feature runs its owner tests in every language its parity units bind; it runs cargo test, go test, PHPUnit and node

scripts/features/languages.mts.reason: the language set of the feature checks from config/parity.json, a rule of this repository

scripts/features/owners.mts.reason: selects and runs the owner check of changed files (AGENTS.md Owner checks), a rule of this repository

scripts/features/packages.mts.reason: the package directory of each client language of this repository, as config/release.json labels them

scripts/features/select.mts.reason: selects the verify commands and helper checks of contracts/features.json, the manifest of this repository

scripts/free-ports.mts.tool: node:net listening on port 0, which the operating system answers with a free port

scripts/group-rows-physical-check.mts.reason: the physical rule of this repository that the grouped-result owners leave the same database state twice

scripts/install-cli.mts.reason: installs dbspec-fmt under a declared prefix without a symbolic link, the path rule of polyspec (as polyspec/template installs template-fmt); npm link would make a symlink

scripts/package-check.mts.reason: checks the four client packages as a consumer builds them; it runs npm pack, Composer, cargo and go

scripts/perf-test.mts.reason: the hot-path gates of this repository against the seeded MySQL bench database

scripts/php-without-mysql.mts.reason: the rule N17 of this repository that the PHP client runs on SQLite with no MySQL driver loaded; it runs PHPUnit under php -n

scripts/php/php-min.mts.reason: finds the PHP of the lowest release that composer.json declares, so the client is tested on its declared floor, a rule of this repository; it reads PATH and brew --prefix

scripts/physical.mts.reason: the shared steps of the physical checks of this repository, which compare the database state before and after the owner tests

scripts/publish-output.mts.reason: publishes a build output by rename so a reader never sees a half file, the crash-safety rule of polyspec

scripts/repo/check.mts.reason: the repository check of this repository: the CI workflow gives the database servers through make orm-test-servers and runs the one declared Node

scripts/repo/ci.mts.reason: the rule of this repository that the CI workflow starts the database servers and passes their variables as make orm-test-servers does; it reads the workflow with yaml

scripts/repo/kit-copies.mts.reason: the copies of @polyspec/kit from kit.copies of the installed package, so the rules of this repository skip them

scripts/repo/messages.mts.reason: the rule of this repository that a failure message states its cause and its fix

scripts/repo/node.mts.reason: the rule (kit K171) that one Node version declared in mise.toml runs every check and workflow

scripts/repo/probes.mts.reason: the rule of this repository that a client sends no probing statement on connect

scripts/repo/scripts.mts.reason: the rule of this repository that every path in a root npm script is tracked

scripts/repo/sources.mts.reason: the source rules of this repository for JavaScript, Rust and PHP files, such as process groups started detached

scripts/repo/target.mts.reason: the rule of this repository that a Rust program path comes from the declared CARGO_TARGET_DIR

scripts/repo/testcases.mts.reason: the rules of this repository about deadlines, case reports, leases and test runners over the commands that unbash reads

scripts/repo/toolchains.mts.reason: the rule of this repository that one file declares the PHP and the Rust that every check and workflow runs

scripts/test-servers-mysql.mts.reason: compares the declared MySQL settings with an existing data directory and moves the data when they differ, for the test servers of this repository; it runs mysql and mysqldump

scripts/test-servers.mts.reason: starts and stops the database servers of the checks of this repository under .runtime/servers on free ports; it runs mysqld, postgres, ProxySQL and PgBouncer

scripts/typescript/node-min.mts.reason: prints the bin directory of the lowest Node of engines.node that mise installs (mise where node@<version>, with the version mise.toml pins in mise.lock); ts-min-check runs the TypeScript tests on it, and the script downloads nothing

scripts/typescript/sqlite-test.mts.reason: runs the TypeScript integration tests on SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL with the servers of make orm-test-servers, the parity rule of this repository

scripts/unselected-column-physical-check.reason: the physical rule of this repository that selected and unselected generated PHP fields leave the same database state twice

scripts/version/check.mts.reason: the rule of this repository that every version declaration matches VERSION; it reads them with semver
